justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/QueueInputStream.java and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/QueueOutputStream.java, plus src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/QueueInputStreamTest.java. The Builder is very small and cohesive: it has only 2 state fields (BlockingQueue<Integer> and Duration), 1 constructor, 2 setters, and 1 build method, and its only responsibility is validating defaults and constructing QueueInputStream. The tests exercise just these two configuration knobs, with no sign of multiple separable responsibilities, excessive size, or low cohesion.
